incident_updates.body:
Block production on Solana mainnet beta resumed at 14:57 UTC, following a successful upgrade to v1.17.20 and a restart of the cluster by validator operators. Engineers will continue to monitor performance as network operations are restored.


The outage began at approximately 09:53 UTC, lasting 5 hours. Core contributors are working on a root cause report, which will be made available once complete.
Engineers from across the ecosystem are investigating an outage on mainnet-beta
This incident has been resolved.
The Solana community successfully restarted the cluster - engineers will continue to monitor network performance

A coordinated restart is underway to address an issue during the upgrade from 1.13 to 1.14 that caused block finalization to slow significantly.

Validators: please follow updated instructions below https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vQVMKVqh1o-qF4Z8ATM-Qxa_FhT96qoCmqGHFroq4e1EbrHkfg-H8Q8Z_FRnX3mYOxRgBbK6yzDols_/pub

Engineers are currently investigating slow root production on mainnet beta.

2023-02-25 05:46:16 UTC the Solana network entered degraded mode (vote-only). This means that economic activity on the network stopped while the network attempts to recover. Core contributors of the protocol are working to identify the root cause of this issue.
The Public RPC and Explorer endpoints are online.

incident_updates.body:
Mainnet beta Public RPC endpoints and Explorer are currently offline as RPC node software is upgraded, following a bug in a test release 1.14. This bug impacted other nodes which had adopted the test release. If you are operating a node on a test release, please change over to 1.13. 

Block production has not been impacted and the Solana network remains online.

incident_updates.body:
Validator operators successfully completed a cluster restart of Mainnet Beta at 7 AM UTC.

Network operators an dapps will continue to restore client services over the next several hours.

The Solana network is experiencing an outage and not processing transactions. Developers across the ecosystem are working on diagnosing the issue and to restart the network. More information will be provided as it becomes available.
The Solana Network is currently experiencing degraded performance. Developers across the ecosystem are working on diagnosing the issue and more information will be provided as it becomes available.
This incident has been resolved.

On-chain time continues to run behind that of wall clocks, due to longer-than-normal block times. While this has no impact on performance or network operations, the time reported by block explorers and dapps may not reflect wall-clock time.

An issue with Vercel caused a wrong deployment to be promoted to production.
With the adoption of 1.8.14 the incident has been resolved.

Solana mainnet beta is experiencing high levels of network congestion. This is related to issues previously identified that engineers have been working to improve and resolve, starting with the 1.8 release. 1.8.12 was specifically aimed at improving issues of  program cache exhaustion, which are largely responsible for recent performance degradations. Developers have made lots of progress on this, but the work is not complete. The last 24 hours have shown these systems need to be improved to meet the demands of users, and support the more complex transactions now common on the network.  

The current issue experienced by validators is due to excessive duplicate transactions. Engineers have just released 1.8.14, which will attempt to mitigate the worst effects of this issue. These forthcoming releases are aimed at improving the state of the network, with more improvements expected to roll out in the next 8-12 weeks. Many of these features are currently live on Testnet, where they are being rigorously tested.

Release 1.8.14 is now available at https://github.com/solana-labs/solana/releases/tag/v1.8.14
The mainnet-beta cluster is experiencing performance degradation, we currently investigating the issue.
We are continuing to investigate this issue.
The mainnet-beta cluster is experiencing some performance degradation, we currently investigating the issue.
The public endpoint https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com was down due to abuse, several batched RPC calls were been spammed at the time.

As of this post, Mainnet beta release 1.8.12 is live on the majority of validators. This release is specifically aimed at improving network cache exhaustion issues. Developers are continuing to monitor the network.

The Solana Network is currently experiencing degraded performance due to an increase in high compute transactions, which is reducing network capacity to several thousand transactions per second. This is leading to increased loading and transaction processing times, and some failed transactions. The network is currently not correctly accounting for high compute transactions but developers across the ecosystem are working to address these issues and improve network resiliency.
